notes.title: The update that's NOT an update!
notes.content:
New in this version (1.0.215)


ABSOLUTELY NOTHING!!!!!!

As I was about to release [b]Don Flatus: Poop Hunter[/b] back in November 2020, the programming language used to make the game had a massive update. It caused all sorts of glitches, crashes and problems so I have been using an outdated version of the language since the games release.....

Until now!

All the issues caused by the language update have been dealt with (I hope!). So this version should be [i]exactly[/i] the same as 1.0.214 (still hoping!)

If you are seeing anything that is different or are getting any bugs, please get in touch

Thanks for your time,
Scott A. Cooke
Creator of Don Flatus: Poop Hunter

notes.title: Continued Animation Update
notes.content:
New in this version (1.0.214)


SKELETAL ANIMATIONS

1) In the last update I announced the start of converting bitmap animations into skeletal animations. In this update I have continued converting more of the animations. You probably won't even notice the change but this work is freeing up processing power for a BIG change that I'm working on!

BEHIND THE SCENES

2) I have continued work on the game engine. As a player, you won't really see anything (YET!). The work that has been done will enable [i]big[/i] changes and advancements for future updates.

If you have anything you would like to see, please get in touch.

notes.title: 1st Update
notes.content:

2) PlugBugs go off screen (Most noticable in level 5) - FIXED
